notes.title: Happy Holidays! Patch 2.0.5.6
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/20ce84918d1936a526f03938162c0628697a6fe0.png

Patch Notes   2.0.5.6


So it begins...

The time for my vacation is finally here, sorry that the patch didn’t come on the 15th as promised. I used the extra time to weed out as many bugs as I could find. I have completely re-done the skeletons causing the lag issues and the room cap has also been raised to 85! A couple new mechanics have been added and a few tweaks to the system have been made too.


Before Reading Further
In light of the holiday season I have hid 4 digital artbook keys within this and other "Patch Note" posts. You must already own the game to be able to activate one of these keys, the first to activate the first to receive! 

(Edit) I almost forgot, Uagi-Saba now includes "Tiny Creature". The little creature you see hanging out with me on my Twitch streams is now available for all owners of Uagi to use for their own streams. Set your game to 1600 resolution windowed mode, Click the tiny orb on the lower right of the title screen, use obs to capture the Uagi screen, chroma key out the maroon color. Drag to bottom edge of screen, (minimized and the creature wont animate.) Page up changes body parts, page down changes face color, home restarts. Tiny Creature has a lot of history and I thought it only fair to provide it to all Uagi fans.


New Egg Hatch Clock And Mini Game
The system for hatching eggs has been completely reworked. Eggs no longer have a shown health box and stat. Eggs now have an "Egg Spirit" that floats above, it beats like a heart. The faster it beats the healthier your egg. An eggs movement speed now increases based on how close it is to hatching. Along with these new changes I have introduced a light/sound click type min-game to help the player reduce egg hatch time. If you see a glowing ball appear in your eggs "Egg Spirit" click it and a series of orbs will appear. If you click them all fast enough it will reduce the egg hatch clock.


Smog As A Hazard
Originally smog drifted near mystics but it was changed last minute to fix lag issues. Smog now drifts near mystics AND inhabitants. A few more modules now create smog as well making air purifiers crucial for a safe sanctuary.


End Game Info
Some seem to be a little confused about endgame. The first major thing needed is for the Great Machine to appear. This will appear before you reach your room cap. The rest of what is needed to end the game is found in clues that can be read using the farsight skill on memory objects. These clues will then hint as to what else is needed.

End Game TIPS
-When memory objects are destroyed during room renovations they are gone forever, Giant stones and broken computers will continue to appear if destroyed. There is a small chance though if you destroy too many broken computers and giant stones you may not find all you need to end the game, careful what you destroy.
-Objects related to end game: memory objects, broken computers, giant stones, the great machine.
-Mystic skills are needed to access all end game objects.


Essence Beetles
Something you may have yet to notice are essence beetles, they will appear randomly on walls then disappear. Collect these to unlock a special in-game achievement. 



Patch Notes 

-Room cap has been increased to 85.
-Fixed odd clicking bug with stone ovens and recycle button.
-Fixed the double egg bug.
-Fixed crash involving lore books.
-Fixed problem with the shrine upgrade in the HUB upgrade screen.
-Room cap has been increased.
-Now costs 25 scrap to cap a smog vent
-Fixed bug where cost box wouldn’t show for smog vents.
-Fixed bug where mystic health would not drop due to cold temps.
-Fixed bug where name change button control would stay visible and could be selected when on the gen table screen.
-Smog clouds will now move towards mystics.
-So it begins...  P3Y9T-CCIJV-RIT5C
-Added new section in HUB info screens and tutorial about new egg system.
-Fixed bug where costs for fermentation tank would show up without border box during fermentation cycle.
-Fixed bug where loading in-game would start a second song.
-Fixed bug where baby mystics would destroy nearby egg pedestals when they would grow into adult mystics.
-Fade now appears correctly at end game.

notes.title: Post Release Hot-Fix 2.0.4.6
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/375805461a0a408ec468003141358182e71c0fef.png


Hot-Fix Patch 2.0.4.6

I was hoping I wouldn't have to do a patch so soon after release but things seem to have gotten a bit shaky. Some serious issues came to light involving crashes with hatching eggs in 1600, I made a new branch to help for the time being but I wanted to get the stable build out to everyone.

The build was so messy and so many things were changed that i needed to wipe saves. Sorry for the inconvenience I was not expecting this many issues.

 Along with fixing a couple other game crash issues I have also made some tweaks to Uagi and have done some optimization that should help with the FPS problems people are having.


Patch Notes

-One of the bigger changes is max room cap, the cap is currently 50 and will go up the more I optimize Uagi with each patch.
-Rooms now have less light, the need for lanterns will be greater and makes for a better look.
-Fixed any Spine skeletons that had too many mesh points, this was causing lag.
-As much as I like keeping Uagi realistic sometimes one ends up with 3 males or 3 females, waiting for eggs to hatch and getting the same sex over and over kind of leads to a dead end for breeding with time spent.
There is now a better Male to Female ratio, this should make for a less frustrating experience.
-Egg hatch times have been reduced along with room charge times and build times, the player still gets a bonus from engineers just in smaller increments.
This makes for less waiting and more game play, I want the player to have a couple eggs going sooner than later.
-Though egg hatch times have been reduced health reduction times for eggs have been increased.
-1600 Egg crash has been fixed.
-Fixed crash involving the furnace or ferm tank when renovating a room.
-Mystics originally could get sick from smog clouds, smog clouds now drift towards mystics and will get them sick if they have low antibodies, this is where air purifiers come into play.
This still needs tweaking but I want to improve on it in future patches.



I wanted to make more changes but I had to get this patch out asap due to how bad the crashes and fps problems were, crunched hard to get this one out. But, lots of new ideas and fixes in store. Below are some things you can expect to see in the next major patch.


Coming Soon

-More optimization, balance and bug fixes.
-Higher room cap
-New animations
-A new way to interact with eggs to speed up hatch time.
-New ways to interact with your mystics.
-Hazards to make things a bit more exciting.
-Improvements to the speech system.
-New content, body parts.
-Improvements to the way modules affect creatures and inhabitants.

notes.title: The Monster Halloween Patch 2.0.3.3
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/375805461a0a408ec468003141358182e71c0fef.png


Dev Blog/New Patch 2.0.3.3

Happy Halloween! 

YES! The biggest content patch since EA release. Super excited to get this into everyone's hands.
Got a lot of new content for ya just in time for Halloween! I have also made some general balance changes and regular bug fixes, those will be included in the patch notes below.

This is an optional update, to opt in right click Uagi-Saba in your Steam games list. Then click properties, click betas, then click "select the beta you would like to opt into" and select "uagitest".
This content will go live for the default build November 10th.

I hope you enjoy the new patch, stay safe this Halloween. UG



Mystic Skill System

After a long wait the mystic skill system is now live. All three skills that can be taught to mystics will help the player progress towards the end game. The three skills are "Smash", "Repair" and "Far Sight". First to even teach a skill to a mystic the mystic must have an intelligence rating of 4 or above. Depending on what skill you want to teach you also need to have a high enough rating of the corresponding stat. Smash (Strength) Repair(Intelligence) Far Sight (Wisdom).


Skill Objects

New objects have been introduced to be used with the new skill system.

Giant Stones- Giant boulders that can be broken apart with the Smash skill. What might you find?

Broken Computers-Use the Repair Skill to fix these old computers and learn more about what happened to sanctuary before the meteor hit.

Memory Objects-Use the Far Sight skill to read into old memories attached to these special objects. These objects have a swirling blue green orb above them. WARNING these can be destroyed and lost forever when renovating a room.

End Game

With this patch I decided to lock the Great Machine button to restrict players from ending the game after they have met the requirements, That will be coming in the next patch. I still wanted to introduce the skill system though in case players wanted to play around with it a bit and discover some hints about ending the game.

-If you would rather wait to see the ending complete I recommend waiting for full release November 30th to update.
-Requirements needed to end the game I will not disclose. "Hints can be found within the memories."




New Body Part Coloring System

I am happy to finally introduce the new body part coloring system. Previously a mystics entire body was colored with one tint based off three color genes. Now with the new system each individual body part has it's own three color genes. This vastly increases the possible mystic look combinations and makes each mystic really feel unique.



New Room Biomes

Originally for this patch I was only going to include the new vine room biome but since I finished the ancient room biome in time I thought I would hand that over as well. Bordered with old runes these warm rooms are filled with flat glowing stones, inspired by my love for Mignola and Guillermo. Come with their own spawns and a new plant species. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/200db4853431024f3129fa06aef60f58b3275747.jpg

03AI7-HG3RG-CIBZX

New Plant Pack

The first plant pack to be introduced into sanctuary. One new plant species has been included for each room biome type. For the default rooms biomes the "Cave Blades" hearty grass sharp enough to cut skin. For the cool vine biome, the "Stone Suckers" barnacle like growths that suck minerals from the stones they grow from. Lastly for the muggy ancient room biome I have created the "Fingers Of The Beast" a worm like tube plant that dances slowly in the dark.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/356bceeea993ccba82254500d05935a26a5bd1d6.jpg


Full Release

A little more than a month till full release on Steam, November 30th is the planned date!
Up until then I will be working on a few last minute things. 
Here is a list of what to expect next patch.

-The in game achievement system will be finished, currently is locked.
-Player will be able to press the button on the Great Machine and end the game if they meet the requirements.
-Finishing the two animated end game story screens.
-More balance changes.
-More added to the tutorial.
-Completed Art book for Uagi.




Patch Notes From 2.0.3.3

-Added new "Other Upgrade" Self harvesting Fermentation tanks.

-Fixed problem with back cloud and haze creators not destroying with room renovations, would create overlapping clouds and haze.

-Increased the distance at which essence extractors receive a synergy bonus ic close to other extractors.

-Mushroom Gardens now cost 5 stone instead of 10 stone.

-The Improved mushroom farm upgrade now costs 75 Lore and 200 Essence instead of 150 Lore and 250 Essence.

-Added different color text within the info section of the HUB for easier reading.

-Added info about the skill system and skills within the HUB info section.

-Added info about holding shift to move camera faster in the HUB info section and in game controls menu.

notes.title: Crank the Heat, Patch Notes 1.0.3.3
notes.notes:
Dev Blog/New Patch 1.0.3.3

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/20ce84918d1936a526f03938162c0628697a6fe0.png

Greetings, UG Here

    Coming to you with a small patch. Though small still very important as I have completely scrapped the old temperature system. The new one is much easier to understand and should make the game more enjoyable. Let's be honest Uagi-Saba is not a furnace simulator and in the end I don't want it to be the focus of the game. I was going to wait till I had the skill system completely working for this patch but I wanted to get the new temperature system out to the players.
 
I have also added three new back pieces to the mystic gene pool, added some polish to various assets and have made a few bug fixes.


A little more on the new temperature system

Furnaces now only have one temperature level instead of three and rather than have all kinds of ups and downs in temperature there is only one increase/decrease per cycle. The temperature difference that will take place is now shown to the player in the HUD so they now how much it will increase or decrease per cycle. I have removed the "Kelvin" temps from the HUD and now only Fahrenheit and Celsius remain. Long story short it is a much easier system to understand and should remove some of the frustrations some players have been having. 5D9TX-EN9BT-GTLDT
 Fill your furnaces, wait for the change in temp to be displayed then make changes accordingly.


Coming Soon
   
    The next patch should be pretty hefty as it will contain the new mystic skill system, very excited about this as it will ultimately let the player progress to endgame. The player will be able to teach their mystic skills based on the stats their mystic is born with. The player can then use skills to smash large rocks, reveal secrets, decipher ancient texts and repair old computers to get closer to end game.



		Patch List Below
		
		
-Re-arranged the main player HUD a tad.
-Fixed bug crash involving the new furnace buttons.
-Removed old temp system.
-Furnaces now only have one temperature stage.
-Removed Kelvin from the HUD.
-The change in temperature per cycle is now displayed on the HUD.
-Added three new back pieces to the gene pool, two from the beast family and one from the material family.
-Two of the three new back pieces are only available through breeding with wild mystics, I have made more of the back pieces now available to default mystics.
-Added new buttons to the build menu. Button on far left now opens skills when pressed.
-Pressing "Q" now opens and closes skills.
-Though I have added new skill buttons they have all been turned off until next patch, come next patch they will all be usable.
-Fixed problem where eggs created through breeding would sometimes destroy egg pedestals.

notes.title: "Each Is Unique" Patch 1.0.3.2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/375805461a0a408ec468003141358182e71c0fef.png


"Each Is Unique" Patch 1.0.3.2

Greetings, Hope everyone has been enjoying their time in sanctuary.
Pretty excited with this new patch, got a few new major changes along with some important bug fixes.

One of the more important additions is the new mystic "Trait System". Mystics now have a small chance to be born with a "Trait" gene, a unique perk that can effect your mystic in negative or positive ways. A couple examples, the "Brute" trait will increase your mystics strength stat. The
"Long Runner" trait will drastically increase your mystics lifespan. A total of twelve traits have been added and more are to be added in the future. Currently trait bonuses stack so if parents pass the trait on to their children the offspring will receive 2x the bonus. This opens up some interesting new ideas and possibilities for the future.

In preparation for the coming mystic skill system I have also added two new main stats, Strength and Wisdom. Stats are also passed down from parent to offspring. Both Traits and Main Stats can be seen in the mystics HUD.

Another big change, all of the machine module buttons have been updated and all reflect their stages with similar colors. Green (Ready To Run) Orange (Running) Purple (Ready To harvest).

I have completely redone all of the mini map icons. The old ones made no sense and were very confusing. The new icons are more visually descriptive. 


Patch note list below, some things above are covered again below.
Currently planning for a full release sometime in December, thanks again for all of your support.  UG



Patch Notes 1.0.3.2

-Fixed problem where player could press the name card button multiple times even when the mystic HUD was already open.
-Added click sounds for clicking out of the mystic HUD.
-All new mini map icons.
-Fixed problem where some objects would not show their icon on the mini map.
-Fixed problem where some mini map icons would draw in the wrong place.
-Fixed problems with furnaces disappearing.
-Fixed issues where upgrade buttons in the HUB upgrade screens were not displaying correctly, some would highlighted for upgrade when player did not have the required resources.
-I have completely re-worked all buttons for most machines. The forge, furnace and stone oven have all had their button art and colors changed. Should be easier for the player to tell what stage their machines are in. "Green Off, "Orange" Running, "Purple" Finished, ready for harvest. Furnaces only have orange and green, "on" and "off".
-Fixed problem where multiple gene packets could be created off one mystic of the same sex after a gene packet had previously been destroyed.
-Clicking on build nodes will now destroy gene packets, clicking the backspace key will also cancel a breed.
-Fixed problem where naming a mystic would also re-name the mystic above or below.
-Workers will now eat and drink less frequently.
-Worker goodies are given out less often.
-Fixed problem where name change button for mystics could not be pressed.
-Added two new main stats, Strength and Wisdom. These will effect the skills coming in the next big patch.

notes.title: The Dust Settles Patch Notes 1.0.2.2

New Patch 1.0.2.2 8/8/2018


Greetings,

    Been crunching hard the past couple days to get through all of the bugs. I have changed many things based on player feedback as well. Some of the main issues still involved major bugs but many players were having a hard time finding enough of certain resources etc. I have made a few tweaks to balance and object spawn rates.
  
  Players have also been having a hard time understanding mechanics due to me not providing enough information, to help with this I have added more bits of info here and there within the tutorial and HUB info screens. Another major addition is the color changes to temp text in the UI. The text will now change color based on the temp in sanctuary, this should better help the player visually understand safe and stable temp levels.

    We have gotten through most of the major bugs and Uagi is now pretty stable. I can really start to concentrate on more player feedback and new content. I cannot guarantee it but the next patch should be on a different branch, so the player can choose whether or not to update. 

    I know balancing is not yet perfect, that will take a while to tweak. I will continue to make patches and things should get smoother. I hope these changes will make your Uagi experience a bit more enjoyable. UG


-Fixed problem where build buttons would not play a click sound when destroying with left mouse.
-Stone piles now give larger amounts of stone when harvested.
-Fixed problem where one of the tutorial boxes at the tutorials start was being skipped. The one covering harvesting resources (stone, mushrooms etc.).
-Junk piles now have a chance to give out multiple resources, including more stone.
-Adult mystics now generate 5 essence instead of 10, baby mystics now generate 2 essence instead of 5.
-Water pools now generate less water per cycle.
-Fixed problem where player could drag camera while HUB menu screen  was open.
-Changed the spawn position of the HUB screen tutorial box, also fixed problem where player could not close it by clicking the "x" close button.

-Added click sounds when player uses mouse wheel up/down when in the controls sections or options section of the in game menu.
-Completely re-worked the in game main menu screens. Fixed all of the bugs involving closing menus, switching screens etc. and no more overlapping click sounds.
-The player can now close the in game main menu screens using mouse wheel up/down, middle mouse, the movement keys and the right mouse button.
-The temp text in the upper right HUD will now change color based on the temp in sanctuary.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/735b674465fa9a6e7a50bf5491dd6ebf7021ebad.jpg


Greetings,
Past few days have been a bit crazy, all of the feedback and bug reports have been wonderful. Uagi is already on the path to becoming a more solid game. Many problems have been fixed with this patch including the major problem with save games not registering . I know the patching has been  a bit heavy but soon patches should become less frequent. Sorry for any Inconvenience.


Regarding Furnaces And temp

Lately it seems players have been having a hard time keeping their temp in sanctuary balanced. Let me go over a few things. Each room in sanctuary will generate a small amount of "cold". The more rooms you have in sanctuary the more cold your temps will stay. Having furnaces in your sanctuary will help raise your temps. Each furnace has three heat levels. Level 1 (10 and under) Level 2 ( above ten below 20) Level 3 (above 20). The higher the level the more heat produced. To add fuel to a furnace press LEFT MOUSE, to remove fuel RIGHT MOUSE. The temp of sanctuary will stay around it's default temp of 34 degrees F if sanctuary has no heat. A healthy temp range is 65-94 degrees F. I  have also made some slight changes to heat output for furnaces, this should help a bit too. Keeping your temps balanced can take some practice. Keep and eye on your temp and adjuest heat levels accordingly, if your current furnaces can't keep up build a couple more. Hope this helps.
Remember, the "lore and other info" section of the HUB screen (computer) is your friend, most everything Uagi can be found here. 


Patch Notes 1.0.2.1

-fixed spelling errors in story screens.
-Fixed problem where HUB screen would open and camera would keep moving if player pressed hub open button (bottom right) while moving the camera.
-Fixed problem where options menu would open and camera would keep moving if player pressed options open button (bottom right) while moving the camera.
-For some reason I had the forges which are used to make alloy cost alloy to build. This made it impossible to build them. Changed the cost to 100 energy and 25 scrap, removed the alloy cost.
-Fixed problem where destroyed furnaces would leave behind their recycle control object. Causing recycle buttons to appear later if right clicked.
-Re-did egg health boxes, they are a bit darker now so text inside is easier to read. I have also added custom green and red used buy the text to show high and low health.
-Fixed issue where if player pressed the "P" key while entering a mystics name game would pause.
-Had a problem where sometimes saves would not save, this should be fixed.
-Dig site boxes now have a chance to give ore.
-Fixed problem where dig site boxes would harvest automatically even if "junk runners" was not yet unlocked.
-Fixed problem where dig site boxes were crashing the game if "junk runners" was unlocked.
-Fixed issue where in game menu would appear if player pressed the escape key to exit out of the HUB screen.
-Fixed problem with overlapping click sounds opening and closing menus and build buttons.
-Fixed problem where pressing the options menu button with room build buttons and floor build buttons still open wouldn't destroy them properly.
Fixed problem where player could click on a room renovation button while HUB menu was open.
-Player can now hold shift while using wasd to move camera to move it around faster than normal speed. This can also be done using drag camera.
-Much harder to get wild mystic rooms now.
-Added small note about the mystic word list in the wrong command response for the mystic HUD
-Fixed problem where offspring egg would crash if original parents were dead, this had to do with the generation variable not being passed on correctly through the womb.
-The backspace key will now cancel a breed if gene packets are visible and player decides to not go through with breed.
-Fixed problem where the exit button for the in game menu would stop working after clicking out of "options" or "controls"
-Slightly changed heat output for furnace levels.

notes.title: Uagi Update, We Have Released
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/375805461a0a408ec468003141358182e71c0fef.png


Greetings, UG Here

    First, thanks a bunch to everyone for your support releasing Uagi-Saba into Early Access. For the most part it was a smooth release but Uagi is still far from being finished. I already have had a lot of new feedback since and new changes are already being implemented.
    
A head sup, when new patches go up there is a chance certain part of save files become lost or changed. I will have multiple branches so players can choose to update to a new build when they are ready to do so.
    
Being in Early Access these kinds of things are expected and I know losing game saves can be frustrating. I will do my best to make patches as smooth as possible and as developement progresses small patches will come less often.

     I have made a list of things I and other players have already found that I will be fixing for the next patch. List below.


  A Few Changes Made Before Release

-Added new artwork for eggs, eggs now also have skins. 
-Fixed issue with intro music not looping.
-Added sound effects for clicking on lanterns and crystals.
-Both QWERTY and AZERTY controls and settings should work properly now.



Problems Already Noted

-Game Crash involving interact objects, found that they were not being properly destroyed when moving the camera with the middle mouse button. Resulting an invisible clickable object that will crash the game. This has been fixed and will be in the next hotfix patch. To avoid this refrain from using middle mouse to move camera until patch is made.

-Tutorial boxes dissapear way too quickly, player does not get enough time to read full way through.

-Odd to have exit button on left side in HUB screen, may move this to the right side.

-Wild mystic rooms are too easy to find, I will be changing this.

-Egg health text can be hard to read, will be changing this and adding new custom colors.

-The mini map icons honestly are a complete mess, I really need to figure out a new way of doing these as glowing balls of different colors could cause problems with people who have color blindness etc. They are confusing and hard to understand, I will be working on changing this soon. Any suggestions are welcome.

-There are still things in Uagi that need to be better explained, good temp range, where water pumps can be built etc. Want to remove these confusing moments for the player.




The Future Of Uagi In Early Access

Now that we have released into EA I can breathe a little again and start getting back to making Uagi even better. The main focus in EA will be adding an end game and a mystic skill system that will lead to that very moment.  Besides that I want to build on what I already have, I have some great new ideas that are in the works thanks to player feedback.


The Next Month Or So

-New room types, backgrounds, borders and biomes.
-Mystic Traits, a chance that some mystics may be born with special traits, changing their eating habits, boosting stats and causing mutations.
-New body parts, parts that include fur and feathurs. Mutations based off the enviroment and local temps.
-Skill system, teach mystics skills the same way you would words. Use these skills to repair, translate and smash bigger rocks. The repair skill is implemented but currently turned off until I get broken computers working.

Stats will effect what skills a mystic can learn.

G9T4B-WW58Y-YM4EZ

notes.title: Uagi-Saba Patch Notes/Dev Log (0.0.1.3)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32385683/375805461a0a408ec468003141358182e71c0fef.png



UG here with another blog entry/patch notes post! It is indeed an exciting time, we have a month left till we release onto Steam. Uagi-Saba the newest in creature breeding and genetics officially releases into Early Access August 1st 2018.    


(Edit 7/3/2018) New hot fix lists have been added at the bottom, a total of four hot fix patches have been made since the 1.0.1.3 build went live. We are now officially on build 1.0.1.7 and pretty stable. Thanks to all of the beta testers for your help.


 
This is a big patch with a bunch of new content and fixes, some areas have had some big improvements. I will go over some of the bigger changes and the rest can be found in the patch list at the bottom.

Three new room types and two new modules have been added to the game. The Gen Room (brings in large amounts of energy) and the Mushroom Farm (large scale mushroom grow operation). The Shrine module (generates lore) and the A.S.D.S. (automatically feeds and waters your mystics).

The Wild Mystic Room is a new room that has a chance to appear after you have charged enough empty rooms. When it appears it will automatically spawn a special egg, if you are able to hatch it you will spawn a wild mystic! 

The speech system has been drastically improved, a variety of new phrases and words have been added. 40 plus words, and many phrases related to hunger, thirst, loneliness etc.

The camera can now be moved by clicking the edges of the screen, this is still a little buggy.
Some rooms, entities and modules now have a new Synergy mechanic. Some examples... Placing essence generators close to each or will bring bonuses to energy harvest. Lore keepers close to a study will bring in extra lore. This is still a new mechanic and I plan to add other bonuses soon.

I have completely re-designed most of the mystic lower arms, they have a new "naked" look which I think will leave the door open to some interesting new skin patterns and colors in the future.

Wild mystics have access to very rare genes, genes that are only available to them. Breed a wild mystic with one of your own to bring these rare genes into your pool.

The mutation system has been completely re-worked with the new Wild Mystic Room in mind. Default mystics will have access to most of the basic body part genes.  More genes will become available through mutations based on how many generations the mystic has gone through.


Things I know of that have yet to be added...
-A pause function.
-Smooth zoom.
-Alarms for dig sites.
-Lore books are now out of date and need to be revised.
-The gene pool and achievements buttons in the HUB screen cannot be pressed, these will be implemented soon.



The rough patch note list is below, some things already covered above are also on the list.
 

Patch Note List     1.0.1.3
-Added synergy mechanic for the essence gen and essence extractor, the closer they are to similar modules or rooms the more resources they will generate.
-Added synergy for lore keepers, lore keepers close to studies will generate slightly more lore.
-Bond must now be high enough to interact.
-Added a variety of colorful crystal props.
-Intelligence needs to be high enough to interact.
-Added intro story screen with story, player can click through text to skip.
-Added two new modules, the ASDS and the small shrine.
-Added two new room types, the mushroom farm and the generator room.
-Added new words for mystics to learn, total of 40 words.
-Added new creature speech responses.
-Added new Mystic body parts.
-Fixed bug where player could not charge nearby rooms after new rooms were built or charged.
-Fixed problem with water pump building anywhere regardless of water source being close enough.
-Fixed problem where bond meter would increase after pressing the interact button, now it only increases if the mystic successfully learns the word.
-Fixed problems with build button "locked" text and "not enough resources" text not appearing or causing crash.
-The gen table now includes a color mutations stat and a body mutations stat. If your mystic has a mutation through breeding it will show up here as an increase.
 


Hot Fixes 1 From Patch 1.0.1.3        7/3/2018
-Added middle mouse cam drag, this is just a test. Still very sensitive and is based on mouse sensitivity . (Edit) This has been fixed, with help from a few of our UG fams we now have a very smooth cam drag. Removed old cam movement buttons from screen edges.
-Fixed bug where giant arrow button would appear when a ferm tank would be recycled.
-Player will now be refunded half of what they paid for modules when a room Is renovated.
-Fixed problem where certain objects would give the player guardian rating points if they were destroyed during room renovations.
-Fixed problem with mushroom spore visibility.
-Fixed problem with the disappearing furnace.
-Added an object that controls the deactivation of certain objects outside of the view, hopefully this helps with some of the frame rate issues.
 -Fixed problem where crystals, the a.s.d.s module and shrine module wouldn't disappear when a room was renovated.



Hot Fixes 2 From Patch 1.0.1.3        7/5/2018
-Fixed bug where giant arrow button would appear when a ferm tank would be recycled.

-Player will now be refunded half of what they paid for modules when a room Is renovated.

-Fixed problem where certain objects would give the player guardian rating points if they were destroyed during room renovations.

-Fixed problem with mushroom spore visibility.

-Fixed problem with the disappearing furnace.

-Added an object that controls the deactivation of certain objects outside of the view, hopefully this helps with some of the frame rate issues.




Hot Fixes 3     1.0.1.6     7/8/2018
-Fixed problem with mushroom gardens creating two mushrooms.
-Fixed problem where recycling a furnace would leave it’s button behind.
-Fixed problem where player would have to click gen table twice to get it to register. Fixed problems with player being stuck on gen table screen and not being able to move cam.
-Fixed problem where on of the furnace spites was causing extreme lag.
-Fixed problem where player clicking the mystic name card would create multiple mystic text object.
-Fixed problem with player being able to drag camera while in the mystic/inhab hud screens.
-Fixed problem with tut button not disappearing when pressing escape in the HUB screen.
-Drag speed for camera is now faster when fully zoomed out in mini map mode.
-Fixed typos in tut start.
-Fixed problem where “cannot breed” text would appear if right clicking near baby mystic.
-Completely re-worked the ini file system. Options like windowed mode and sound volume will now save correctly and when player loads back in later they will be the same as the player left them on exit.
-Fixed problem with game crashing when player tried to load a game if save file does not exist.
-Fixed problem with sound volume being much loader when a game was loaded.
-Pressing the escape key during the story screen skips to the title screen.
 

 

Hot Fixes 4     1.0.1.7    7/10/2018
-There were still problems with sound volume loading incorrectly, fixed this.
-Added windowed/fullscreen buttons to the in-game options screen.
-Fixed problem with smog vent cost text drawing at the incorrect position while in 1600 resolution.
-Fixed problem where player could click on charge button while in mini map view.
-Fixed problem where player could click on inhab with mini map open.
-All in game menu screens now destroy accordingly using middle mouse, movement keys or mouse wheel.
-Fixed problem where player could still click on build nodes while in the main in-game menu.


Now that we are through that here is some more useful info/social media etc. 

The beta testers will be receiving their keys today fore the next round of testing. Keys for streamers, youtubers and other media coverage will be given out July 20th. If interested please get in contact with me.
